faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for PNGRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive applications for the Private Secretary / Personal Assistant posts is 27-08-2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Private Secretary / Personal Assistant posts is 56 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for these posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 35,400 to Rs. 112,400 per month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for PNGRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: As per the provided data, the total number of vacancies for Private Secretary and Personal Assistant posts is 0.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have at least 5 years of experience as a PS/PA with a senior officer (not below Director rank), be proficient in MS Office, and understand office procedures.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for PNGRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, Skill Test, Document Verification, Interaction/Interview, and finally, the preparation of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of PNGRB. The link is provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for the Private Secretary / Personal Assistant posts is on a contract basis.
